# Case

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Control Flow](Language-Features-Control-Flow)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Case value
Case value1, value2, ...
```

## Description

A part of [Select](Select): the statements after it run when the selected expression equals one of the listed values. Several values are separated with commas.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
s$ = "b"
Select s$
	Case "a"
		Print "A"
	Case "b", "c"
		Print "B or C"
End Select
```

```text
B or C
```
